description: This file defines the ClientManifestProvider class responsible for creating and providing a manifest of locally available grain interface types in the Orleans framework. It includes methods for constructing the interface manifest and manages internal data structures related to grain interface properties.

classes.name: ClientManifestProvider
classes.description: An internal class responsible for creating and providing a manifest of grain interface types available locally.

methods.name: ClientManifestProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider and creates the client manifest.

methods.name: CreateInterfaceManifest
methods.description: Static method that constructs an immutable dictionary representing the grain interface manifest by processing interface options and properties.
